fixes.action: Updated git origin remote to https://github.com/kinksid/DramaPlay.
fixes.result: Future pushes target the requested DramaPlay repository.

fixes.action: Ran gh auth setup-git to connect existing GitHub CLI auth to git HTTPS pushes.
Added favorite, comment, and share controls to the vertical APP preview.
fixes.result: The preview better communicates short-video engagement and sharing behavior.

fixes.action: Added an up-swipe next-episode cue to the vertical APP preview.
fixes.result: The prototype better supports continuous viewing and short-video style retention.

fixes.action: Added heat, completion, and interaction-count chips to home feed cards.
fixes.result: The home feed better supports fast short-video style content decisions.

fixes.action: Added a direct preview CTA to home feed cards.
fixes.result: The feed reduces the distance from discovery to interactive playback preview.

fixes.action: Changed the feed card wrapper from button to article before adding a nested Link.
fixes.result: Interactive markup remains valid and safer for browser behavior.

fixes.action: Reworked the home continue area into a continue-watching card with progress and APP preview link.
fixes.result: The home page now better supports return-user retention and unfinished interactive paths.

fixes.action: Added recommendation sort modes for hotness, completion, and interaction density.
fixes.result: The feed can now be tuned toward discovery, retention, or interactive-depth goals.

fixes.action: Added recommendation reason text to home feed cards.
fixes.result: The feed better communicates personalization and why a user should try each interactive title.

fixes.action: Added a page-local 'not interested' action to hide feed cards from the current recommendation list.
fixes.result: The feed now has a basic user feedback loop for tuning recommendations.

fixes.action: Added an undo strip for the most recently hidden recommendation.
fixes.result: Users can recover from accidental negative feedback without reloading the page.

fixes.action: Added Studio-compatible worlds/stories rewrites, route-backed world detail tabs, and world-card detail navigation.
fixes.result: The P0 worlds IA now resolves through both Studio aliases and local world-builder routes without inventing unverified Studio controls.
